tool_schemas.name: search_google_scholar_key_words
tool_schemas.description: Runs a Google Scholar keyword search for the given query, fetches up to num_results results using the requested locale, normalizes and stores the discovered papers/authors, and returns a persisted per-request snapshot of the results (not paged; num_results limits the returned set). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if query is empty/invalid or num_results/locale are malformed, UNAUTHORIZED if api_key is missing/invalid, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if the caller exceeds configured rate/usage limits. Raises UPSTREAM_ERROR when Google Scholar cannot be reached or returns an unexpected response, and STORAGE_ERROR if the snapshot/entities cannot be persisted.

query.description: Keyword query text to search on Google Scholar.

num_results.description: Maximum number of results to request and store for this search.

locale.description: Locale/region code to use for the Google Scholar request (e.g., en, en-US, zh-CN).

api_key.description: API key used to authenticate the request.

tool_schemas.name: search_google_scholar_advanced
tool_schemas.description: Builds and executes a Google Scholar search from the provided advanced criteria, retrieves up to num_results matches in the given locale, persists normalized papers/authors plus a snapshot for this run, and returns that snapshot (not paged; num_results bounds the result set). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if criteria is missing/invalid or if num_results/locale are malformed, UNAUTHORIZED if api_key is missing/invalid, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when rate/usage limits are exceeded. Raises UPSTREAM_ERROR for fetch/scrape failures or unexpected upstream responses, and STORAGE_ERROR if the run snapshot or entities cannot be saved.

criteria.description: Advanced search criteria object used to build the Google Scholar query.

num_results.description: Maximum number of results to request and store for this search.

locale.description: Locale/region code to use for the Google Scholar request (e.g., en, en-US, zh-CN).

api_key.description: API key used to authenticate the request.

tool_schemas.name: get_author_info
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a Google Scholar author profile for author_id in the requested locale, returning the stored author entity when present or re-fetching and updating it when refresh=true. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if author_id/locale are malformed, UNAUTHORIZED if api_key is missing/invalid, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if the caller exceeds configured rate/usage limits. Raises NOT_FOUND if the author profile does not exist upstream, UPSTREAM_ERROR when the upstream fetch fails, and STORAGE_ERROR if the author record cannot be created or updated.

author_id.description: Google Scholar author identifier to fetch the author profile for.

locale.description: Locale/region code to use when fetching the author profile.

api_key.description: API key used to authenticate the request.

refresh.description: Whether to force re-fetching the author profile even if it exists in storage.

tool_schemas.name: list_search_requests
tool_schemas.description: Lists previously persisted search requests for the authenticated caller, optionally filtered by status, tool, query text, and created-at range. Returns a paged collection ordered by created_at desc. Refuses UNAUTHORIZED if api_key is missing/invalid and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if rate/usage limits are exceeded.

api_key.description: API key used to authenticate the request.

tool_name.description: Filter by tool that created the request.

query_contains.description: Case-insensitive substring filter applied to query_text.

created_after.description: Only include requests created at or after this time (RFC 3339 timestamp).

created_before.description: Only include requests created before this time (RFC 3339 timestamp).

tool_schemas.name: get_search_request
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single persisted search request by id. Returns the stored request including status and error fields when present. Refuses NOT_FOUND if the id does not exist (or is not visible to the caller) and UNAUTHORIZED if api_key is missing/invalid.

api_key.description: API key used to authenticate the request.

search_request_id.description: Primary id of the search_requests row to fetch.

tool_schemas.name: cancel_search_request
tool_schemas.description: Attempts to cancel a queued or running search request. Transitions status queued->cancelled or running->cancelled when possible, sets finished_at, and persists an error_code of CANCELLED when applicable. Refuses CONFLICT if the request is already terminal (succeeded/failed/cancelled), NOT_FOUND if the id does not exist, and UNAUTHORIZED if api_key is missing/invalid.

api_key.description: API key used to authenticate the request.

search_request_id.description: Primary id of the search_requests row to cancel.

reason.description: Optional human-readable cancellation reason to store in error_message.

tool_schemas.name: list_search_results
tool_schemas.description: Lists persisted per-request result snapshot rows for a given search_request_id, ordered by rank asc. Returns a paged collection of search_results including paper_id and raw_result. Refuses NOT_FOUND if the search_request_id does not exist, and UNAUTHORIZED if api_key is missing/invalid.

api_key.description: API key used to authenticate the request.

search_request_id.description: Search request id whose snapshot results should be listed.

tool_schemas.name: get_paper
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single stored paper entity by id. Returns the normalized paper record as last persisted (deduplicated by scholar_cluster_id internally). Refuses NOT_FOUND if the id does not exist and UNAUTHORIZED if api_key is missing/invalid.

api_key.description: API key used to authenticate the request.

paper_id.description: Primary id of the papers row to fetch.

tool_schemas.name: get_current_identity
tool_schemas.description: Returns the calling identity for the provided api_key, including its status, scopes/entitlements for this MCP server, and current quota/rate-limit counters. Refuses UNAUTHORIZED if the api_key is missing/invalid or revoked.

api_key.description: API key used to authenticate the request.
